issues: Kamerstuk II III A, nr. II

concepts.label: Free womb
concepts.title: Children born to enslaved mothers declared free

tiers.label: strict
tiers.rule: child/birth + slave + free word within 25 words

tiers.label: born free
tiers.rule: kinderen + geboren + vrij within 15 words, a slave word within 150

tiers.label: loose
tiers.rule: child/birth + slave + free word within 60 words

tiers.label: context
tiers.rule: kinderen + emancipatie/vrijverklaring within 12 words, in a document with a strict hit

slots.child / birth: words ending in kind, kinderen, kroost, nakomelingen, geboren, geborenen, geboorte …
slots.enslaved: words containing slav, slaaf, lijfeigen (also OCR slips such as s1av, siav)
slots.free: words starting with vrij (not vrijdag, vrijwel, vrijwillig …) or containing emancip
